mandate.title: Your commission is withdrawn
mandate.text: Her Majesty thanks you for your services and relieves you of your place on the War Council. You will hand your papers to Count Harrach.

remarks: The Conference has met twice without you.

reports.title: Relieved
reports.text: By Her Majesty’s command your commission is withdrawn.

hidden.chronicle: Test chronicle: the player is dismissed.

decisions.knows: The Emperor is dead; Vienna is in mourning and short of money.
decisions.decides: Keeps his counsel and orders the regiments readied, quietly.

changes.title: Relieved of your commission
